stories.title: TTC operators warn of crunch as back-to-school ridership surges
stories.angle: Local / national take: Is your morning commute getting worse — and who's to blame?
bullets: TTC reports double-digit ridership jumps on Line 1 and key bus corridors since Labour Day.
Union and city officials trade blame over staffing gaps and delayed vehicle deliveries.
Riders share viral clips of packed platforms at Bloor-Yonge during rush hour.

stories.summary: Toronto's transit system is feeling the September squeeze as students return and ridership climbs. Union leaders say staffing shortages leave operators stretched, while the city points to long lead times for new streetcars and buses.
